ai_summary:
According to the threat finding, "Total IOCs" means there are no indicators of compromise (IOCs) found so far. Malicious indicators of compromise have not been detected so far. The "IPs" and "Domain(s)" identified were considered as potential IP addresses for the attacker to use in their campaign. However, there were no IPs or domains detected during the threat investigation.

The "Hashes" identified were all stored in a single bucket, suggesting that they belong to the same threat actor or group of actors. The "Malicious" indicators found are malware signatures or other indicators of compromise that have been publicly disclosed by security researchers.
